start: Admin app, owner signed in, Help and feedback, 'MettleUp access'

user_sees: Sheet 'Let MettleUp support look?' saying support can read members, plans, receipts, check-ins, shop orders and staff list for the next hour
must_not: The window opened without the sheet

user_sees: The window listed as open with its end time

start: Admin app, front desk signed in

steps.action: Try to open or close support access
must_not: The desk opening the gym to support

start: Admin app, a support window open for 20 minutes

user_sees: The window listed as ended early

steps.action: Tap 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)' again
user_sees: A new hour starts; the old window and its looks stay listed
must_not: Two open windows from the gym at once

start: Admin app, 'MettleUp access', HQ opened an emergency window last week

user_sees: Each window: who opened it, why, from when to when, and each look with what and how many rows
must_not: An emergency look missing from the list
Words saying support looks only when the owner lets them while an emergency window is listed

start: HQ app, a gym whose owner opened support access

user_sees: Up to 200 member records, newest first, read-only, and the window's end time

steps.action: Open check-ins and the staff list
user_sees: Each look written down with its kind and row count

start: HQ app, a gym with a fault stopping the desk, no window open

steps.action: Open emergency access: pick 'locked_out', write a reason of 10+ letters, pick 30 minutes
user_sees: A window of 30 minutes; audit row 'support_open'

start: HQ app, a gym with no window open

steps.action: Open emergency access for 45 minutes or with a 5-letter reason
Wait past the end of another window and open records
must_not: Records shown after the time is up

start: HQ app, one gym's access log

steps.action: Open the access log with no window open
user_sees: Only when and what (sign-in, push, pull) and counts

steps.action: Open it while a window is open
user_sees: Person, device and address, and the look listed for the owner
must_not: A detailed look the owner cannot see
